project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Test whether the weakly positive but cost-insufficient R3J dense-opening signal becomes economically useful when entry is delayed until an explicit five-minute persistence confirmation. Preserve the opening-only hypothesis and Q0.70 extremity; change entry timing/confirmation rather than economic gates.

predecessor_evidence.R3H: Opening Q0.70 had strong but sparse 2023 economics.
predecessor_evidence.R3J: Dense opening first-event Q0.70 produced 30 trades, net3 +0.7598bps PF1.0794 but net5 -1.2402bps, H1 slightly negative, and top-1-percent removal negative; 2024 remained unopened.
predecessor_evidence.design_inference: The opening setup may contain information but next-minute entry is too early/noisy. Require observable same-direction persistence before committing capital.

initial_signal.candidate_direction: sign of NIFTY causal 30-minute return at initial checkpoint; positive=CE, negative=PE
initial_signal.adaptive_history: previous 126 completed trading-date observations at the same clock checkpoint only
initial_signal.gap_condition: abs NIFTY opening gap >= previous-history Q0.70
initial_signal.momentum_condition: abs NIFTY causal 30-minute return >= previous-history Q0.70
initial_signal.sensex_confirmation: SENSEX causal 15-minute return has same sign as candidate
initial_signal.vix_confirmation: India VIX causal 15-minute return has opposite sign to candidate
initial_signal.session_location_confirmation: CE requires NIFTY session_pos>=0.65; PE requires session_pos<=0.35

persistence_confirmation.nifty_condition: NIFTY causal 5-minute return at confirmation has same sign as candidate and is nonzero
persistence_confirmation.sensex_condition: SENSEX causal 5-minute return at confirmation has same sign as candidate
persistence_confirmation.vix_condition: India VIX causal 5-minute return at confirmation has opposite sign to candidate
persistence_confirmation.session_location_condition: CE requires confirmation-time NIFTY session_pos>=0.65; PE requires <=0.35
persistence_confirmation.scan_rule: scan initial checkpoints chronologically; if an initial setup fails five-minute persistence confirmation, it is rejected and later initial checkpoints may be evaluated; accept the first confirmed event only per date

horizon_router.trend_threshold: median over previous 126 completed trading-date observations at the confirmation clock checkpoint
horizon_router.entry: next genuine same-session minute open after confirmation

qualification.if_2023_passes: freeze configuration and then open 2024 audit
qualification.if_2023_fails: retire R3K without opening 2024; preregister distinct R3L before any R3L output

option_gate.data: genuine 2024 full-chain NIFTY option candles from authorized Sep-Oct expiry weeks
